description: Establish the WS2 baseline and the frame-time measurement capability. Confirm the environment builds/lints green on the visual/lighting-quality branch, then capture a BEFORE baseline (fixed-camera screenshots of ALL FOUR 3D scenes) and BEFORE frame-time readings on the Fast-equivalent path (today's rendering) for each scene, under docs/visual/. scripts/measure-load.mjs captures bytes + a fixed-camera screenshot but does NOT measure frame time, so a frame-time capture must be ADDED (either extend measure-load.mjs with an opt-in --measure-frametime flag that runs a requestAnimationFrame timing loop over the mounted canvas, or add a sibling scripts/measure-frametime.mjs reusing the same server+launch+base-path plumbing). This feature is the frankfabric analog of the WS1 baseline step and is a prerequisite for proving 'Fast path no slower than today' and 'no skin blow-out'. NO scene/lighting code changes in this feature.
steps: Confirm npm resolves (nvm Node v22.23.2). Run `npm install` in /projects/sandbox/frankfabric.

Run `npm run lint` and confirm it is clean except the single expected @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning in app/layout.tsx (0 errors). Run `npm run build` and confirm the static export into out/ succeeds and all five pages prerender.

Add a frame-time capture capability. Preferred: add a new flag to scripts/measure-load.mjs (e.g. --measure-frametime) OR a sibling scripts/measure-frametime.mjs that reuses the same http server, chromium launch args (executablePath /usr/local/bin/chrome, --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --ignore-gpu-blocklist --no-sandbox), viewport 1280x900, and /frankfabric base-path mounting. After the canvas mounts and settles, run an in-page requestAnimationFrame loop for ~5s (do NOT disable animations for this measurement) that records per-frame deltas, and report median + mean + p95 frame time (ms) and derived FPS. Keep it a measurement tool, not part of the build. Write a small JSON per run.

Capture the BEFORE baseline for each of the four scene routes (/projects/coach-trainer/, /projects/chef-chatbot/, /projects/digital-wardrobe/, /projects/virtual-pet/): a fixed-camera screenshot via measure-load.mjs (screenshots go to docs/visual/, e.g. --out docs/visual --label before-<scene>) AND a frame-time reading via the new harness (also under docs/visual/, e.g. before-<scene>-frametime.json). Since there is no quality selector yet, today's rendering IS the Fast-path-equivalent baseline; label the frame-time files clearly as the pre-change/today reading.

Write docs/visual/BASELINE.md recording: the machine (Linux sandbox x86-64, software GL SwiftShader), Node v22.23.2, Chrome for Testing version (read it from the harness/browser), viewport 1280x900 dpr 1; the four BEFORE screenshot paths; the four BEFORE frame-time numbers (median/mean/p95 ms + FPS); and an explicit note that absolute FPS is software-rasterized and only the RELATIVE before/after Fast-path comparison is meaningful.

Do NOT commit out/, node_modules/, .next/, or assets-src/. Confirm .gitignore already excludes them (WS1 established this). Commit ONLY the new/changed script(s) and the docs/visual/ baseline artifacts on branch visual/lighting-quality with a conventional-commit message (e.g. `chore(visual): add frame-time harness + WS2 before baseline`).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` is clean except the one expected font warning; `npm run build` static export succeeds with all five pages prerendered.

A frame-time capture harness exists (new script or new flag) that launches headless Chrome, mounts a scene route, runs a requestAnimationFrame timing loop, and writes median/mean/p95 frame time + FPS to JSON.

docs/visual/ contains a BEFORE fixed-camera screenshot AND a BEFORE frame-time JSON for each of the four scenes (coach, chef, wardrobe, pet), plus BASELINE.md documenting machine+browser+viewport and the numbers.
docs/perf/ is untouched (WS1 evidence not overwritten).
No scene/lighting .tsx files changed in this feature; git status shows only script(s) + docs/visual additions; out/ node_modules/ .next/ assets-src/ are not staged.
verification: Run `npm run lint` and confirm only the expected font warning.
Run `npm run build` and confirm out/index.html and all four project route index.html files exist.
Run the four before screenshots and four before frame-time captures and confirm the JSON/PNG artifacts appear under docs/visual/ and each frame-time JSON contains a numeric median/mean/p95.
Run `git status --short` and confirm no out/, node_modules/, .next/, or assets-src/ paths are staged.
findings:
Environment: node/npm not on the non-login shell PATH; prepend /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin. `npm install` was a no-op (deps already present). Verification green: `npm run lint` = 0 errors, only the expected @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning in app/layout.tsx; `npm run build` static export produced out/ with all five pages prerendered (verified index.html for /, /projects/coach-trainer, /projects/chef-chatbot, /projects/digital-wardrobe, /projects/virtual-pet).

Added scripts/measure-frametime.mjs (sibling of measure-load.mjs) reusing the same http server + /frankfabric base-path mount + Chrome launch args (executablePath /usr/local/bin/chrome, --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --ignore-gpu-blocklist --no-sandbox) + 1280x900 dpr1 viewport + canvas-mount readiness. It settles 4s then runs a ~5s in-page requestAnimationFrame loop WITHOUT disabling animations, drops the warm-up frame, and writes median/mean/p95 frame time (ms) + derived FPS to JSON.

Captured BEFORE baseline (docs/visual/, NOT docs/perf/): before-{coach,chef,wardrobe,pet}.png fixed-camera screenshots (all ready:true, hasCanvas:true, zero unresolved failures; only benign favicon 404 + resolved RSC-prefetch aborts) and before-{coach,chef,wardrobe,pet}-frametime.json. Chrome for Testing 151.0.7922.10. Software-GL (SwiftShader) so absolute FPS is not hardware-representative; only relative before/after is meaningful. Frame-time medians (ms): coach 83.3, chef 83.3, wardrobe 100.1, pet 250.0. Wrote docs/visual/BASELINE.md documenting machine/browser/viewport, screenshot paths, the four frame-time numbers, and the software-GL caveat.

No scene/lighting .tsx changed; docs/perf/ untouched; out/ node_modules/ .next/ assets-src/ not staged (confirmed via git status). Recorded the chef FBX-vs-VRM discrepancy in BASELINE.md for later tone-mapping-gated features. Commit: `chore(visual): add frame-time harness + WS2 before baseline`.

Note: only scripts/measure-frametime.mjs and docs/visual/ were committed; the .agents/tasks task-state files (this feature JSON and sibling task dirs) are left untracked/unstaged intentionally, matching that they were untracked at session start.
